newsitem.title: USA: Caldor Corp to close four stores.
newsitem.headline: Caldor Corp to close four stores.

text.p: The Caldor Corp said Tuesday it plans to close four stores that have not met the company's required financial targets.
A company spokeswoman said she could not comment on the question of the firm taking a charge related to the closings.
The stores are located in the Bronx, Brooklyn, Westfield, Mass.; and Woonsocket, R.I.
The company said the closings, which are subject to bankruptcy court approval, are expected to be completed by mid-May.

Caldor Corp is the fourth largest discount department store chain in the U.S., with annual sales of about $2.7 billion and about 23,000 Associates. The company said it operates 161 stores in ten East Coast states.

Caldor filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in September 1995. In December, 1996, the company unveiled a comprehensive five-year business plan wich is being reviewed by the company's creditor, bank and equity committees.
The company announced its first round of 12 store closings last March and opened seven new stores during 1996.
